description: Texts with DECtalk's in-text commands standing inside the text, after something has been spoken: the comma pause and the period pause changed between sentences and inside one; words of the speaker definition changed with dv between sentences, inside a sentence, several at once, after a voice command and before one; a rate and a voice changed more than once, together, and back again; a change in front of a comma clause, of a question and of the last word. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.
